name: 25177 · Saint Albans, WV
findings: ZIP 25177 (Saint Albans) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25177 (Saint Albans) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 25177 (Saint Albans) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
